steps.en: Install aider, cd into your git repo and start it with a model
steps.zh: 装好 aider，进到你的 git 仓库，指定模型启动

steps.en: Builds a repo map: a ranked outline of the code's classes and functions
steps.zh: 生成仓库地图：按相关度排序的类和函数提纲

steps.en: Add the files to edit to the chat and ask for the change
steps.zh: 把要改的文件加进对话，提出改动要求

steps.en: Sends those files plus the relevant map to the model and applies its edits
steps.zh: 把这些文件和相关地图发给模型，再把它的修改落到文件里

steps.en: Shows the diff and git-commits the change with a generated message
steps.zh: 展示 diff，并用生成的提交信息做一次 git commit

value.en: Every AI edit lands as its own reviewable git commit, with any model you choose, without leaving the terminal
value.zh: 每次 AI 修改都是一次可审查的 git 提交，模型随你选，不用离开终端

sources: https://github.com/Aider-AI/aider README — Getting Started (aider-install; aider --model sonnet --api-key anthropic=<key>)
aider/website/docs/usage.md (add files to the chat on the command line or with /add; aider shows diffs and git commits all of its changes)
aider/website/docs/repomap.md (repo map built with a graph ranking algorithm); aider/website/docs/git.md (/undo, /commit, --no-auto-commits)
